trace.command: cd /workspace/skills/noacg-graphic/references; sed -n 400,600p contract.md; cat validator.md | head -150; export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; noacg --version || npm install -g /mnt/session/uploads/noacg-cli.tgz; noacg types

export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; which certutil; mkdir -p ~/.pki/nssdb && (certutil -d sql:$HOME/.pki/nssdb -N --empty-password 2>/dev/null; for c in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/*.crt; do certutil -d sql:$HOME/.pki/nssdb -A -t C,, -n "$(basename "$c")" -i "$c"; done); noacg --version; noacg doctor; noacg types | head -40
export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; noacg --version; timeout 120 noacg doctor; noacg types | head -30

export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; mkdir -p /workspace && cd /workspace && noacg scaffold --type lower-third --design neutral --out ./graphic && cd graphic && ls -R . | head -30; cat *.html; cat css/template.css; cat js/template.js

export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; cd /workspace/graphic; noacg record . --out /mnt/session/outputs/record.json | tail -3; noacg screenshot . --state onair --data "f0=Alexandra Konstantopoulos-Vandermeulen" --data "f1=Senior European Economics Correspondent" --background video --out /workspace/shots/long.png | tail -2; noacg inspect . | tail -20
export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; cd /workspace/graphic; noacg coverage . --out /mnt/session/outputs/coverage | tail -15; cat /mnt/session/outputs/coverage/coverage.json | head -60
